_auth_mode: claude-oauth-subscription via proxy/claude_code_bridge (judge runs HOST-side, hence loopback base_url, NOT host.docker.internal)
_temperature_note: no temperature field on purpose: Claude 5 models reject the parameter ('deprecated for this model')
_model_note: author_model + judge_model are prefix-routed litellm ids: anthropic/<m> -> Claude bridge :8765, openai/<m> -> Codex bridge :8766. author_model WRITES the rubrics (TRUTH.md + R-items); judge_model GRADES runs (anchoring gate + judge council, council name derived from it). Keep both Claude for deliveries (fixed measuring stick); an openai judge additionally needs judge_model 'openai/responses/<m>' + base_url on :8766 for the anchor-gate litellm transport.
